newsitem.title: UK: Michael Jackson cancels Taipei concert - Sony.
newsitem.headline: Michael Jackson cancels Taipei concert - Sony.

text.p: U.S. popstar Michael Jackson has cancelled the first of three shows scheduled for Taiwan and has rescheduled the concert for a later date, Sony, his record company said on Tuesday.

Sony Music Entertainment Europe said in a statement in London that Jackson, who arrived in Taipei on Monday, had cancelled a concert scheduled for October 16 due to problems with a flight carrying his stage equipment.
SONY said the concert would be held on October 22 instead and that tickets purchase for the October 16 show would be honoured.
The record company said Jackson would go ahead with two other scheduled concerts in Taiwan, one on October 18 in Taipei and the other on October 20 in Kaohsiung.
SONY said Jackson had to cancel and reschedule the October 16 concert because of "technical difficulties" with Antonov planes carrying his stage equipment from Seoul to Taipei.
Jackson ended a controversial visit in South Korea on Monday.
